thesis.label: Overlapping live-chat workflows, different pricing units
thesis.rationale: Crisp and Tidio both serve website live chat and AI deflection for SMB support teams. The decisive trade-off is Crisp’s flat per-workspace pricing plus Hugo AI credits versus Tidio’s conversation-pack pricing and Lyro/flows automation — not a generic chatbot swap.

pricing.complexityNote: Crisp is flat per-workspace; Tidio is conversation-pack based — not seat-vs-seat comparable without usage assumptions
notes: Crisp Free $0 (2 seats); Mini $45; Essentials $95; Plus $295/workspace/mo (verified 2026-09-06 crisp.chat/en/pricing).
Tidio Starter $24.17/mo annual for 100 billable conversations; Growth from $49.17 (verified Tidio pricing research).

evidence.disclaimer: Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.

notes: Locale-410 gap recovery hand-authored unique analysis 2026-09-06 — not a template substitution of livechat-vs-tidio.

patch.summary: Crisp vs Tidio is flat-rate omnichannel workspace messaging versus conversation-priced live chat with Lyro AI. Prefer Crisp when you want predictable per-workspace cost and Hugo AI credits with a shared inbox. Prefer Tidio when website visitor deflection and billable-conversation packaging fit SMB chat volume better than seat/workspace allotments. Weak fit to treat them as identical chatbot widgets — pricing units and omnichannel depth diverge.
patch.verdict: Choose Crisp for flat workspace pricing plus omnichannel/KB depth on Essentials+. Choose Tidio when Lyro AI deflection and conversation-pack TCO for website chat matter more than Crisp’s seat-included workspace model. Compared with LiveChat vs Tidio, this pair differs because Crisp competes on flat workspace economics rather than Text per-person seats.
patch.pricingNotes: Crisp: Free–Plus flat workspace ($0–$295/mo) with Hugo credits on paid plans. Tidio: conversation packs (Starter ~$24.17/mo annual). Do not convert without estimating monthly conversations vs included Crisp seats/AI credits.

scenarios: Flat per-workspace live chat + shared inbox
Hugo AI credits with omnichannel Essentials+
Lyro AI + flows for website deflection
Conversation-pack TCO for SMB chat volume

scenarioRecommendations.scenario: Startup wanting one flat chat bill as agents grow
scenarioRecommendations.rationale: Crisp Mini/Essentials include seats in the workspace fee; adding agents does not multiply like per-person chat seats until you exceed included allotments.

scenarioRecommendations.scenario: SMB site that needs AI visitor deflection first
scenarioRecommendations.rationale: Tidio’s Lyro/flows packaging is oriented to website chat deflection measured in billable conversations rather than workspace seats.

scenarioRecommendations.scenario: Support team consolidating chat, email, and messaging
scenarioRecommendations.rationale: Crisp Essentials+ documents omnichannel inbox and knowledge base; Tidio omnichannel depth is more limited in current research.

scenarioRecommendations.scenario: High chat volume with predictable conversation packs
scenarioRecommendations.rationale: When volume is conversation-shaped, Tidio’s pack pricing can be clearer than estimating Crisp Hugo credit burn.

outcomes.reason: Crisp Free starts at $0 with 2 seats; Tidio paid Starter is ~$24.17/mo annual for 100 billable conversations. Units differ — Free entry favors Crisp for tiny teams.
Both research a free entry path (Crisp Free forever; Tidio freemium). Limits differ — Crisp Free is seat-capped without Hugo credits.
Both support website live chat as a primary job. Differentiation is packaging and automation, not presence of a chat widget.
Crisp Essentials+ documents omnichannel inbox; Tidio omnichannel support is limited in current enrichment.
Crisp lists knowledge base on Essentials+; Tidio knowledge base is limited in current research.
Crisp Hugo AI is credit-metered on paid plans; Tidio Lyro/flows sit inside conversation packaging. Prefer based on credit vs conversation economics.
Both document ecommerce/helpdesk-style connectors. Validate required CRM/helpdesk connectors on each vendor’s directory before choosing.
Neither is a full ITSM suite. Crisp ticketing is limited/Plus-oriented; Tidio ticketing is limited.
